name: Reverse-Flash
summary: The Flash's biggest fan, turned his worst nightmare. Eobard Thawne, a speedster from the 25th century, travels through time to make Barry Allen miserable.
origin: The Reverse-Flash is what happens when a superfan becomes the worst stalker in history. Eobard Thawne is a man from the 25th century who idolised Barry Allen, copied his powers, then learned he was destined to be Barry's greatest enemy, a fate he embraced with gusto. John Broome and Carmine Infantino introduced him in The Flash #139 in 1963 as Professor Zoom, and his first name came later. He murdered Barry's wife Iris, and a 2009 story made him the killer of Barry's mother too. He taps the Negative Speed Force, is a genius scientist, and turns up wherever in time he can do the most harm.
powers: Super speed from the Negative Speed Force

storyline.title: From the future
storyline.beat: Eobard Thawne, a man from the 25th century, copies the Flash's powers and costume in reverse colours and becomes the Reverse-Flash.

storyline.title: Killing Iris
storyline.beat: Thawne murders Barry Allen's wife Iris, beginning his darkest era as a villain.

storyline.title: Stopped for good
storyline.beat: When Thawne tries to kill Barry's fiancée, Barry stops him by breaking his neck, leading to the long Trial of the Flash.

storyline.title: The worst secret
storyline.beat: Flash: Rebirth reveals Thawne travelled back in time and killed Barry's mother, Nora Allen.

storyline.title: Breaking history
storyline.beat: Barry's attempt to undo Thawne's crime creates the Flashpoint timeline.

gossip.text: A 2009 retcon made him the killer of Barry's mother, Nora Allen.
There has only ever been one Reverse-Flash.
gossip.truth: Eobard Thawne is the classic one, but others have used the name, including Hunter Zolomon and Daniel West.

gossip.text: Tom Cavanagh played him in The Flash TV series, disguised as Harrison Wells.
He comes from the 25th century and idolised the Flash before turning on him.

quiz.q: Which century is Eobard Thawne from?
Whose murder did a 2009 retcon pin on the Reverse-Flash?
What is the classic Reverse-Flash's real name?

theme.tagline: Same speed, opposite colours, maximum spite.

timeline.title: Professor Zoom
timeline.note: The Flash #139 introduces a man from the future who rebuilds himself into Barry's evil twin.

timeline.title: Murder at the masquerade
timeline.note: Zoom kills Barry's wife Iris at a costume party in The Flash #275.

timeline.title: Stopped for good
timeline.note: Barry kills Zoom to save his new fiancee, a choice that puts the Flash on trial.

timeline.title: Flash: Rebirth
timeline.note: Thawne returns, revealed as the killer of Barry's mother and author of his tragic past.

timeline.title: Flashpoint
timeline.note: Thawne taunts Barry in the broken timeline Barry made trying to save his mom.

timeline.title: The man in the yellow suit
timeline.note: Tom Cavanagh plays Thawne in disguise as Harrison Wells in the first season of The Flash.

timeline.title: The Button
timeline.note: Thawne dies after a brush with a mysterious cosmic power in a Batman and Flash crossover.
